title: Press_Anchor re-gate skips the ESC+right+left chord: the swallow latch sticks and the held-left release no longer click-selects (mouse-path delta vs pre-change handle_input)
detail: Same-frame ESC+right+left chord leaves press_swallowed=true (the ESC's Cancel re-latches; Press_Anchor is skipped because placing_eff=-1). Pre-change code cleared the latch, so the held-left release click-selected — now a silent no-op. Probe-verified on the sha: sel_node 1 -> -1; r1's unconditional gate matched old code, so the fix delta introduced this.
recommended_fix: Emit Press_Anchor for every chord that queues a Cancel: gate on has_left && (placing_eff >= 0 || esc_cancelled || (esc_deselect && !inp.drag.active)) instead of placing_eff >= 0 && !esc_cancelled.

title: esc_cancelled = true mis-indented inside the phase-1 Esc case (reads as outside the if-block)
detail: The delta's new flag split indents esc_cancelled = true one tab shallower than its if-body, so it visually reads as outside the branch. Cosmetic only (Odin ignores indentation; no lint gate covers app/), but it obscures the parity-critical cancel/deselect split this round pinned.
recommended_fix: Re-indent esc_cancelled = true one tab deeper to align with esc_deselect = true inside the if/else bodies.
